souvenir.en: a red lantern from 南锣鼓巷

facts.zh: 南锣鼓巷两边有十六个胡同，一边八个。
facts.en: Sixteen 胡同 branch off it, eight on each side, like a centipede's legs.
facts.how: Read the lane signs along the street — all the way to the south end.

facts.zh: 帽儿胡同是你住的胡同。
facts.en: 帽儿胡同, one of the sixteen, is your lane.
facts.how: Read the sign at the corner of your own lane.

facts.zh: 雨儿胡同里有画家齐白石的家。
facts.en: The painter 齐白石 lived in 雨儿胡同.
facts.how: Go in by the gate in 雨儿胡同 and talk to the guide.

facts.zh: 作家茅盾的家，也在这里的一个胡同里。
facts.en: The writer 茅盾 lived in 后圆恩寺胡同.
facts.how: Go in by the gate in 后圆恩寺胡同.

facts.zh: 东棉花胡同里有一个学校，学生在学做演员。
facts.en: 东棉花胡同 has the drama academy, where students learn to be actors.
facts.how: Walk east along 东棉花胡同 and listen to the students.

souvenir.en: a print of 齐白石’s shrimp

facts.en: 齐白石 is most famous for his shrimp.
facts.how: Look at the picture in the window.

facts.zh: 一九五五年，他九十多岁，住在这里。
facts.en: In 1955, over ninety, he lived here.
facts.how: Ask the guide what he painted.

facts.zh: 他的画室还在，桌子上有笔和纸。
facts.en: His painting room is still as it was, brushes and paper on the table.
facts.how: Read the sign on the painting room.

facts.zh: 茅盾是作家，写了很多书。
facts.en: 茅盾 was a writer who wrote many novels.
facts.how: Talk to the old man at the gate.

facts.en: He lived here for seven years, 1974–1981.
facts.how: Ask how long he lived here.

facts.zh: 院子里有他的白色石像。
facts.en: His white marble bust stands in the yard.
facts.how: Look at the bust in the yard.

en: The new courtyards of 菊儿胡同

souvenir.en: a pot of flowers from the shared yard

facts.zh: 这些院子是新的，也像老的。
facts.en: These courtyards are new, and still look like the old ones.
facts.how: Read the plaque in the yard.

facts.zh: 这里的院子得过联合国的奖。
facts.en: They won a United Nations award (the World Habitat Award, 1992).
facts.how: Talk to the woman who lives here.

souvenir.en: an opera mask from the drama students

facts.zh: 这里有一个学校，学生学做演员。
facts.en: The drama academy is here; its students learn to be actors.

facts.zh: 十五号有一个很老、很好看的门。
facts.en: No. 15 has a very old, beautiful carved brick arch.

facts.zh: 以前，钟和鼓告诉大家现在几点。
facts.en: In the old days the bell and the drum told the city the time.
facts.how: Read the sign on the Drum Tower.

facts.en: The Drum Tower had twenty-five drums: one for the year, twenty-four for the solar terms.

facts.zh: 钟楼的钟很大，有六十多吨。
facts.en: The Bell Tower's bronze bell weighs about 63 tonnes.
facts.how: Read the sign on the Bell Tower.

facts.zh: 门口的两个狮子，一个是男的，一个是女的。
facts.en: Guardian lions come in pairs: a male with a ball, a female with a cub.
facts.how: Find out which lion is which, by the towers.
